import z3

# Define the grid
grid = [[z3.Int(f'g{i}_{j}') for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]
s = z3.Solver()

# Constraints: numbers 1 to 36 distinct
vals = [grid[i][j] for i in range(6) for j in range(6)]
s.add(z3.Distinct(vals))
s.add([z3.And(v >= 1, v <= 36) for v in vals])

# Compute sums
row_sums = [sum(row) for row in grid]
col_sums = [sum(grid[i][j] for i in range(6)) for j in range(6)]
diag1 = sum(grid[i][i] for i in range(6))
diag2 = sum(grid[i][5-i] for i in range(6))
all_sums_list = row_sums + col_sums + [diag1, diag2]

# Min and max
min_s = z3.Int('min_s')
max_s = z3.Int('max_s')
s.add(z3.And([sum_val >= min_s for sum_val in all_sums_list]))
s.add(z3.Or([sum_val == min_s for sum_val in all_sums_list]))
s.add(z3.And([sum_val <= max_s for sum_val in all_sums_list]))
s.add(z3.Or([sum_val == max_s for sum_val in all_sums_list]))
s.add(max_s == min_s + 13)
s.add(min_s >= 104)
s.add(min_s <= 105)

# Try to solve with timeout
s.set("timeout", 30000)  # 30 seconds
result = s.check()
print(result)
if result == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    grid_vals = [[m.evaluate(grid[i][j]).as_long() for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)]
    print(grid_vals)
    # Compute the sums
    r_s = [sum(row) for row in grid_vals]
    c_s = [sum(grid_vals[i][j] for i in range(6)) for j in range(6)]
    d1 = sum(grid_vals[i][i] for i in range(6))
    d2 = sum(grid_vals[i][5-i] for i in range(6))
    sums = r_s + c_s + [d1, d2]
    print(sums)
    flat = [item for sublist in grid_vals for item in sublist] + sums
    print(flat)
    print(min(sums), max(sums))
else:
    print(s.unsat_core())
